description:
## [1.6.1](https://github.com/hyzor/hyzor-morphe-patches/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.1) (2026-11-04)

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **sleep:** support 20261006 only, drop 20260616 ([bc4ead1](https://github.com/hyzor/hyzor-morphe-patches/commit/bc4ead18a70cacac73e9d8a67121dbd8ff29e077))

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Pure black backgrounds instead of chess.com's dark grey, in the newer and the older screens. Switch it in Noam's Patches (then restart the app).

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Your own colour in place of chess.com's green, chosen in Noam's Patches → Accent color: buttons, highlights, icons and text of the app.

patches.name: Arcade animations
patches.description: Adds the chess.com website's Arcade piece animations to every board: light trails, bursts when a piece is picked up, dropped or captured, a flash on check, outlined last-move squares and animated move hints. Switch it in Noam's Patches.

patches.name: Arrows in games
patches.description: Adds Arrows and Clear buttons to the live, daily and pass-and-play game bars, and a small chip over the board in bot games. While Arrows is on, dragging on the board draws an arrow and tapping marks a square, as on the website, and pieces don't move.

patches.name: Board colors
patches.description: Choose the board's square colours: your own, or one of chess.com's colour themes, on every board of the app. In Noam's Patches → Board colors.

patches.name: Clone Chess.com
patches.description: Renames the app to com.chess.noam so it installs next to the real Chess.com app instead of over it. Leave it off to keep updating your current install.

patches.name: Customize Home screen
patches.description: Choose which tiles and sections the Home screen shows, and the order of the tiles.

patches.name: Customize bottom bar
patches.description: Choose the tabs between Home and More (Puzzles, Learn, Watch, Bots, Train) and their order, in Noam's Patches → Bottom bar.

patches.name: Hide Premium-only content
patches.description: Free accounts no longer see what only Premium members can use: Premium-only bots are not listed, and the Premium toolbar button, the Home and More banners and the Settings Upgrade row, the Home diamond, the sale banner and More's Membership row are gone. Nothing is unlocked.

patches.name: Lichess Puzzles
patches.description: Puzzles from Lichess becomes the Puzzles tab's big button, with chess.com's Solve Puzzles above it. Lichess's puzzles play in chess.com's own puzzle screen (board, coach, sounds), rated on the phone the way Lichess rates them; nothing is sent to chess.com.

patches.name: Limits as toasts
patches.description: When a free limit is reached (Game Review, puzzles, lessons, drills, videos…) a short toast says so instead of a full-screen Premium offer, and promotional pop-ups are not shown. Nothing is unlocked: the limits stay exactly as they are.

patches.name: No ads
patches.description: Banner, full-screen and game-over ads are not loaded or shown, and neither are their Remove Ads links: the app's own "ads enabled" state and the account's show-ads flag, which are off for members, stay off.

patches.name: No rating prompts
patches.description: The app doesn't ask you to rate it on Google Play. Switch it in Noam's Patches.

patches.name: Noam's Patches settings
patches.description: Adds a Noam's Patches row at the top of the More tab, where the other patches of this bundle are switched on and off. Patches you did not select do not show up there.

patches.name: Stockfish analysis
patches.description: Stockfish 19 on your phone, offline (arm64): best-move arrows on finished games, the analysis boards, the game explorer and Game Review (in a Lichess review, on the moves Lichess didn't mark), and an eval bar where chess.com has none of its own. It never shows while a game is being played or in puzzles. Patching downloads the official Stockfish 19 (80 MB) from Stockfish's GitHub, so it needs internet.

patches.name: Time controls under a minute
patches.description: The custom time slider goes below one minute: 10, 15, 20, 30 and 45 seconds, with or without increment, the way the website allows. Labels read "30 sec" and "0:30+1".

patches.name: Unlimited Game Review
patches.description: Game Review asks who reviews the game: chess.com, Lichess's servers (online, with your Lichess account) or, with the Stockfish analysis patch, Stockfish on your phone (offline, no daily limit). A Lichess or phone review is scored the Lichess way (accuracy, centipawn loss, and inaccuracies, mistakes and blunders) and shown in chess.com's own review screen. Finished games only; a live game on screen is never analysed.

patches.name: Unlimited Play Coach
patches.description: Removes the one-free-game-per-day limit on Play Coach, a bot-only practice mode.

patches.name: Unlock Premium content
patches.description: The app's own premium-tier check always answers with the top tier, so content gated on it (lessons, drills, insights, themes, puzzle-rush extras and anything else that reads the account's tier) treats the account as a member. The server still decides what you may actually play online.

patches.name: Unlock all bots
patches.description: Every bot in Versus Bots can be played, including ones only Premium members may play.

patches.name: Disable dynamic app icon
patches.description: Prevents Duolingo from changing the app icon. Only the default icon will be available.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall. Some features like AI video calls may not work.

options.description: Choose which type of premium Duolingo subscription to enable.

patches.name: Enable debug mode
patches.description: Enables hidden debug menu in settings.

patches.name: Unlimited RampUp time
patches.description: The timer for RampUp challenges will never decrease.

patches.name: AMOLED Black
patches.description: Paints the app's own dark theme pure black (#000000) instead of dark grey, for OLED screens. Native UI only: the games themselves are WebViews with their own web CSS and stay dark grey.

patches.name: Unlock Subscription
patches.description: Reports the account as an active Games subscriber, unlocking subscriber-only archives and bonus puzzles. Client side only; the backend may still refuse some content.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches.name: Enable Prime
patches.description: Unlocks Nova Launcher Prime by starting the app in the prime state and reporting an active subscription, so the settings and features gated on Prime are available.

patches.name: Enable Cloud Premium
patches.description: Reports the Sleep Cloud subscription as active. Client side only; the backend may still refuse.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Sleep as Android Premium. Tap Wait I already Paid when Prompted
